            color: #e2e8f0;
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            overflow-x: hidden;

        .terminal-grid {
            background-size: 40px 40px;
            background-image: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(34, 44, 55, 0.15) 1px, transparent 1px),
                              linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(34, 44, 55, 0.15) 1px, transparent 1px);
        }

        .ambient-lamp {
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(255, 176, 58, 0.08) 0%, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.02) 45%, transparent 70%);
        }

        .keycap-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15), inset 0 0 15px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.05);
        }

        .keycap-glow:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 0 45px rgba(255, 176, 58, 0.25), inset 0 0 20px rgba(255, 176, 58, 0.1);
        }

        .code-reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(20px);
            transition: all 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }

        .code-reveal.active {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .cursor-blink::after {
            content: '|';
            animation: blink 1s step-end infinite;
        }

        @keyframes blink {
            from, to { color: transparent }
            50% { color: #38bdf8 }
        }

        .isometric-card {
            transition: transform 0.4s ease, box-shadow 0.4s ease;
        }

        .isometric-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.01);
            border-color: rgba(255, 176, 58, 0.3);
        }
    </style>

            const currentY = window.scrollY;
            
            if (video) {

            if (currentY > 60) {
                nav.classList.remove('h-20', 'border-transparent');

            }

        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (!scrollActive) {
                window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    runScrollLogic();
                    scrollActive = false;
                });
                scrollActive = true;
            }
        }, { passive: true });

        const observerParams = {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: "0px 0px -40px 0px"

        const revealCallback = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    revealCallback.unobserve(entry.target);
                }
            });
        }, observerParams);

        document.querySelectorAll('.code-reveal').forEach(node => revealCallback.observe(node));

        const mockInput = document.getElementById('terminal-input-mock');

        let deletionActive = false;

            const currentString = sequences[sequenceIndex];

                mockInput.textContent = currentString.substring(0, characterIndex + 1);
                characterIndex++;
                
                if (characterIndex === currentString.length) {
                    deletionActive = true;
                    setTimeout(processTypewriter, 2000);
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                mockInput.textContent = currentString.substring(0, characterIndex - 1);
                characterIndex--;
                
                if (characterIndex === 0) {
                    deletionActive = false;
                    sequenceIndex = (sequenceIndex + 1) % sequences.length;

            }
            
            setTimeout(processTypewriter, deletionActive ? 40 : 100);
        };
